home.heroTitle1: Showcase your dishes and products beautifully
home.heroTitle2: and make ordering effortless for your customers
home.heroBody: Create your restaurant's digital menu or your online store in minutes, and start growing your business and receiving orders right away.
home.sectorsTitle: Every business owner has a digital path
home.sectorsBody: Whether you serve the finest dishes or sell the best goods, everything is ready for you to reach your customers wherever they are.
home.sectorRestaurantBody: A digital menu that opens from a QR code, and a link you share with your customers wherever they are: dishes with mouth-watering photos, orders from the app or WhatsApp, and full floor & table management. Your guests order faster — you sell more.
home.sectorStoreBody: A ready online store in your brand identity: products with sizes, colors and options, a shopping cart, and orders from the app or WhatsApp — zero commission on your sales, no developer needed.
home.servicesTitle: Everything your business needs, in one place
home.servicesBody: From digital menus and online stores to order management and analytics — tools built to grow your sales and delight your customers.
home.service1Title: A QR menu in your brand
home.service1Body: A digital menu in your colours and logo — it opens from a QR code, and from a link you share with your customers wherever they are, fast on every device.
home.service2Body: Showcase products with sizes, colors and options, and receive orders directly — an elegant storefront that opens from any phone.
home.service3Body: Customers pick their order and it reaches you neatly formatted, through the app or on your WhatsApp — no middleman, no commission on your sales.
home.service4Body: An interactive layout of your dining hall, waiter assignment per table, and live order tracking.
home.service5Body: Best-sellers, peak hours, and visit growth in clear charts you can act on.
home.service6Body: Certified agents across Syria — they set up your business, train you, and stay by your side.
home.agentsTitle: Start your menu through your area agent
home.agentsBody: In every region of every Syrian governorate there is an agent who knows its restaurants first-hand — usually a food content creator the area already follows. Through them you subscribe and set up a digital menu or an online store, and they are your link to us from the first step.
home.ctaTitle: Your customers are online. Where's your business?
home.ctaBody: Join hundreds of Syrian restaurants and stores growing their sales with Menu Syria. Starting is free — launch within a day.
home.faqTitle: What owners ask before they start
home.faq1Q: How do I sign my restaurant or shop up?
home.faq1A: Two routes, both ending at the same account: register straight from the platform with the Create account button and fill in your own details, or contact your area agent and they handle the registration and setup with you — most of our agents are food creators who know their area, and they shoot your dishes and arrange your menu before handing you a finished account.
home.faq2Q: How do I get an online store in my own brand colours?
home.faq2A: The Create your online store page walks four steps: your store details and type, then identity where you upload your logo and pick your primary and secondary colours with a live preview that shows your products the moment a colour changes, then your location on the map, then contact numbers. You end with a store carrying your colours and logo — no developer, and no commission on your sales.
home.faq3A: Orders arrive from the app or from WhatsApp, whichever the customer picks, and both land in one dashboard sorted by status and time — whether they came from a guest at a table in your restaurant or from someone who opened your menu link at home.
home.faq4Q: Do I need technical skills or a developer?
home.faq4A: No. Setup runs through plain forms, and later edits — a price, a photo, a new dish — take seconds in the dashboard. If you would rather have someone alongside you, your area agent does it with you face to face.

about.metaDescription: Menu Syria — the Syrian platform building digital presence for restaurants and shops, and giving Syrian products the image they deserve.
about.heroTitle1: Syria is entering a new phase,
about.heroTitle2: and its products deserve an image to match
about.heroBody: Menu Syria is a Syrian platform that presents your products the way your restaurant or shop deserves: a digital menu that opens from a QR code, an online store carrying your brand, and orders reaching you from the app or from WhatsApp — gathered in one place.
about.storyTitle: Syrian products are not lacking — the presentation is
about.storyP1: Every Syrian neighbourhood has a kitchen that has been cooking for thirty years, and a workshop making goods that match anything imported. What is missing is not quality. It is the presentation that would do it justice: a photo that shows the dish or the product as it is, a description written with care, and a price you can reach from your phone.
about.storyP2: We started Menu Syria because this new phase needs digital infrastructure, not scattered social media pages. A place where an owner holds their own menu, store and data, and updates it in a minute.
about.beforeText: A paper menu that fades and lags behind every price change, photos that do the work no justice, and orders lost in a message thread.
about.afterText: A menu that opens from a QR code, prices that change in a second, and orders arriving in order — from the app or from WhatsApp.
about.offerTitle: Everything you need to show your products as they deserve
about.offerBody: Tools built for the Syrian market as it is: they work on a weak connection, in Arabic first, and at prices small businesses can carry.
about.offer3Name: Orders from the app or WhatsApp
about.visionBody: That every Syrian business has a digital presence worthy of what it makes — and that "Made in Syria" becomes a mark people look for, not one they explain away.
about.missionBody: To put simple, fairly priced digital tools in the hands of every restaurant, shop and craftsman, and to stay with them until they own the tools — because digital transformation is never software alone.
about.valuesTitle: Four rules we do not trade away
about.value1Body: Every screen is designed to be read from the right, not translated as an afterthought.
about.value2Body: Quiet interfaces, information where you expect it, and nothing pulling a customer away from ordering.
about.value3Body: Your menu, your customers and your numbers stay yours. Export them whenever you want.
about.value4Body: Agents in your governorate who help you face to face, not support by email alone.
about.restaurantsTitle: A professional menu, not a paper one — working inside your restaurant and beyond it
about.restaurantsBody: We start by replacing the paper menu with a digital one that lifts your restaurant: photos that do the dish justice, descriptions written with care, and a price you change in a second. Then we take it past the table — to a customer who has not arrived yet, and to orders managed through to hand-off.
about.storesTitle: More sales through better order management
about.storesBody: An online store that shows your goods as they deserve — and behind it, management that turns scattered orders into organised work. An order that never gets lost is an order that gets fulfilled, and organisation alone lifts your sales.
about.restaurantsPoint1Text: Opens in a second from the phone camera. No app, no download.
about.restaurantsPoint2Label: A link you share with your customers
about.restaurantsPoint2Text: Alongside the QR code, a link you share with your customers wherever they are: they browse your dishes before they arrive, or order from where they are.
about.restaurantsPoint3Label: And every order in one dashboard
about.restaurantsPoint3Text: Dine-in and outside orders together, sorted by status — pickup at the restaurant, or delivery if you offer it.
about.storesPoint1Text: Products with photos, size and colour options, and a ready checkout basket.
about.storesPoint2Label: Orders from the app or WhatsApp
about.storesPoint2Text: Wherever your customer chooses to order, it reaches you in the same shape.
about.storesPoint3Text: Every order's status and time in front of you, so nothing is lost or left late.

privacy.metaDescription: How Menu Syria collects, uses and protects your data, who can see it, and what rights you have over it.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: We handle your data the way we would want ours handled. This page sets out what we collect, why, and who we share it with — in plain language rather than evasive wording.

sections.title: What we collect
paragraphs: We collect what the platform needs to work, and no more. What that is depends on your role here.
bullets: Business owners: your business name and type, phone number and email, governorate and region, logo and photos, and your subscription details.
Customers: your name and phone number when you create an account or place an order, and a delivery address if you choose delivery.
Agents: your name, phone number, region, and the social accounts you choose to show on your public page.
Technical data: browser, device and pages visited, collected in aggregate to measure performance and catch faults.

sections.title: Why we use it
paragraphs: Every piece of data we hold serves a stated purpose, and each of those purposes is needed to run or improve the service.
We do not sell your data, rent it, or use it for third-party advertising.
bullets: Running your account: building and serving your digital menu or store, and delivering and managing your orders.
Contacting you: messages about your subscription and its renewal, and important alerts on your account.
Support: answering your questions and fixing the problems you report.
Improving the platform: understanding what is actually used, so we develop what is worth developing.

sections.title: Data belonging to a business's customers
paragraphs: When a customer places an order with a restaurant or store through the platform, the order details — name, phone number, and address where given — go straight to the business receiving it, because that business is the one fulfilling the order.

We pass that data on as the operator running the platform on the business's behalf, not as its owner. The business is responsible for protecting its customers' privacy and for not using their data outside fulfilling the order.

sections.title: Sharing information
paragraphs: We share your information only in these cases:
bullets: The technical providers the platform runs on — hosting, image storage and messaging — and only as far as their work requires.
A business you placed an order with, or the agent you subscribed through.
Where a legal obligation requires it, after we have verified the request and its scope.

sections.title: Cookies and local storage
paragraphs: We use cookies and your browser's local storage for operational purposes, not advertising: remembering your language and theme, keeping your session open, and holding your cart and favourites on your own device.
That data stays in your browser and reaches us only as far as carrying out your request requires. You can clear it from your browser settings at any time, which resets your preferences.

sections.title: Keeping data safe
paragraphs: We protect data with encryption in transit, and with access controls so that only the people who need your data to do their job can reach it.
We keep your data for as long as your account exists. When an account is closed we delete the personal data within a reasonable period, except what we must retain for accounting or legal reasons.
No system is completely secure and we will not claim otherwise. But we treat any security failure seriously and notify those affected without delay.

sections.title: Your rights over your data
paragraphs: Your data is yours. At any time you can ask to:
We answer these requests within thirty days at most.
bullets: See what we hold about you.
Correct anything inaccurate, from your dashboard directly or by writing to us.
Delete your account and your data.
Object to or restrict a particular use of your data.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy as the service develops. For any material change we will tell you through the platform or by email before it takes effect, and the last-updated date at the top of this page will change.

terms.metaDescription: The terms governing use of the Menu Syria platform by restaurants, stores, agents and customers.
terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of the Menu Syria platform. By using it — as a business owner, an agent, or a customer — you agree to what follows.

sections.title: Accepting these terms
paragraphs: Menu Syria lets restaurants build a digital menu that opens from a QR code and from a link you can share anywhere, and lets merchants build an online store in their own brand, with management for orders arriving through the app or WhatsApp.
Using the platform or creating an account on it means you accept these terms. If you do not accept them, the option available to you is not to use the platform.

sections.title: Your account
paragraphs: You are responsible for the accuracy of the details you register, for protecting your password and the verification code sent to you, and for everything done from your account.
Tell us immediately if you notice unauthorised use of your account, so we can stop it and secure the account.

sections.title: Subscriptions and payment
paragraphs: Plans and their prices are shown on the platform, and a subscription runs from the date it is activated.
bullets: You can subscribe directly through the platform, or through the approved agent in your region.
If a subscription ends without renewal, the public pages of your menu or store stop working, and your data stays stored for a reasonable period so you can renew without losing it.
Prices may change in future; a change does not apply to a running subscription before its term ends.

sections.title: Your business's content
paragraphs: You own what you upload: your items, their prices and photos, your business description and your logo. You grant us the right to display it on the platform as far as running and presenting your service requires.
You alone are responsible for that content being accurate: prices, ingredients, allergen information, and opening hours. The platform does not review content and does not warrant that it is correct.
We reserve the right to remove content that is unlawful, impersonates someone else, or is abusive, and to suspend an account that does so repeatedly.

sections.title: Orders and the platform's role
paragraphs: The platform is a tool for presenting and managing orders, not a party to the sale. The contract is between the customer and the business directly.
Fulfilment, quality, delivery, returns and invoices are the business's responsibility alone, and any dispute over an order is settled between the customer and the business.
We step in as the platform's operator by making order records available to those involved where needed, not by ruling on the dispute.

sections.title: Agents
paragraphs: An agent is an approved local partner — usually a food content creator in their region — who helps businesses subscribe and set up their menu or store, and introduces them to their own audience.
An agent is not our employee and does not represent us in commitments beyond what the platform itself states. Any promise or arrangement outside the published plans does not bind us.

sections.title: Acceptable use
paragraphs: Users of the platform may not:
bullets: Impersonate another business or person, or present misleading information.
Try to reach accounts or data that are not yours, or probe the system for vulnerabilities without written permission.
Use the platform for unlawful activity or to offer prohibited goods.
Scrape the platform's data automatically, or load its servers with abnormal traffic.

sections.title: Intellectual property
paragraphs: The Menu Syria name, logo, platform design and code are ours, and a subscription grants you no right in them beyond using the service as it is.
Your content stays yours, and you can withdraw it by closing your account.

sections.title: Limits of liability
paragraphs: We provide the service as well as we can, but we do not guarantee it runs entirely without interruption — it may stop for maintenance or for a fault outside our control.
We are not liable for indirect damages, lost profits, or losses arising from content a business published or from a dispute between a customer and a business.
In all cases our liability to you does not exceed what you paid the platform in the three months before the incident.

sections.title: Ending the service
paragraphs: You can close your account whenever you want, from your dashboard settings or by writing to us.
We can suspend an account that breaches these terms, after warning you where a warning is possible and appropriate.

sections.title: Changes and governing law
paragraphs: We may amend these terms, and we will announce material changes before they take effect. Continuing to use the platform afterwards means you accept them.
These terms are governed by the laws in force in the Syrian Arab Republic, and the courts of Damascus have jurisdiction over any dispute not settled amicably.
